interpretation_rules: Observation, explanation, custody, independence, calibration, attribution and novelty are separate dimensions.
Absence is conditional on inspected material, method and sensitivity; missing is not zero.
Unknown knowns means overlooked available context. Unknown unknowns are addressed with discovery probes, not asserted hidden facts.
Historical results remain labeled historical; optional discriminators do not start experiments.
These 42 substantive public abstractions preserve the full semantic fields, with private originals retained separately.
